input._script:
using Base64, JSON3
out = Dict{String,Any}()
d = mktempdir(get(ENV, "WORK", "/tmp"))
try
    import CUDA
    cv = string(pkgversion(CUDA))
    out["cuda_jl"] = cv
    realdepot = first(Base.DEPOT_PATH)
    tmpdepot = joinpath(d, "depot"); mkpath(tmpdepot)
    out["real_depot_untouched_first_depot"] = tmpdepot
    write(joinpath(d, "driver.jl"), String(base64decode("")))
    write(joinpath(d, "jacc.tgz"), base64decode(""))
    run(`tar xzf $(joinpath(d, "jacc.tgz")) -C $d`)
    srcdir = joinpath(d, "JACC.jl-1.5.1")
    envd = joinpath(d, "env"); mkpath(envd)
    setup = """
    import Pkg
    Pkg.develop(path="$srcdir")
    Pkg.add([Pkg.PackageSpec(name="CUDA", version="$cv"), Pkg.PackageSpec(name="Atomix"), Pkg.PackageSpec(name="JSON3")])
    import JACC
    try JACC.set_backend(:cuda) catch e1; JACC.set_backend("cuda") end
    println("JACCVER ", pkgversion(JACC))
    """
    env = copy(ENV); env["JULIA_DEPOT_PATH"] = tmpdepot * ":" * realdepot
    buf = IOBuffer()
    r = run(pipeline(ignorestatus(setenv(`$(Base.julia_cmd()) --project=$envd -e $setup`, env)); stdout = buf, stderr = buf))
    s = String(take!(buf))
    out["setup_exit"] = r.exitcode
    m = match(r"JACCVER (\S+)", s)
    out["jacc_version"] = m === nothing ? nothing : m.captures[1]
    m === nothing && (out["setup_tail"] = last(s, 3500))
    if m !== nothing
        buf2 = IOBuffer(); ebuf = IOBuffer()
        r2 = run(pipeline(ignorestatus(setenv(`$(Base.julia_cmd()) --project=$envd $(joinpath(d, "driver.jl")) $(ARGS[1])`, env)); stdout = buf2, stderr = ebuf))
        out["driver_exit"] = r2.exitcode
        lines = filter(!isempty, split(String(take!(buf2)), '\n'))
        isempty(lines) || (out["driver"] = try JSON3.read(last(lines)) catch; last(lines) end)
        out["driver_stderr_tail"] = last(String(take!(ebuf)), 3500)
    end
catch e
    out["error"] = first(sprint(showerror, e, catch_backtrace()), 2500)
finally
    try rm(d; recursive = true, force = true) catch; end
    out["temp_dir_removed"] = !isdir(d)
end
println(JSON3.write(out))
